name: Archaeological priority area
fact: 796 areas from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2026-05-12; all data from authoritative sources; four-tier archaeological-risk context.
gate: APA geometry is archaeological screening context; exact canonical parcel intersection, current tier interpretation and proposal-specific archaeological assessment remain required.

name: Greater London archaeological priority areas design surface
fact: Co-design stage; related archaeological-priority-area dataset; design notes say the identified update indicator does not cover all Greater London areas.
gate: Design-stage coverage notes do not prove current borough completeness, exact tier or parcel impact.

name: Area of archaeological importance design screen
fact: Screen research identifies statutory AAIs under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Areas Act 1979, used only in parts of Canterbury, Chester, Exeter, Hereford and York.
gate: Legislative description without current authoritative polygons cannot establish that a parcel is inside or outside an AAI.

name: Archaeological remains design surface
fact: Research stage; records and frequency unknown; no related dataset. Archaeology Data Service and Historic England sources are noted but not packaged for this consideration.
gate: Research links and narrative cannot identify site remains or replace a desk-based assessment, field evidence or exact parcel relation.

name: Archaeological notification area design catalogue
fact: Official catalogue lists Archaeological notification area (ANA) at Backlog stage with amenity tag, last updated 2025-06-10.
gate: Catalogue membership is not designation geometry, notification duty or parcel evidence.

name: Historic environment record design surface
fact: Backlog stage; local archaeological sites/finds, historic buildings and landscapes; records/frequency unknown; no related dataset or technical specification.
gate: No operational national layer exists here; absence of platform records cannot establish absence of historic-environment evidence.

name: Locally listed building
fact: 448 records from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2025-11-22; experimental MHCLG-created dataset pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Experimental local-list data requires current adopted local list, asset extent and exact parcel/building relation before use.

name: Local heritage assets design surface
fact: Backlog stage; synonyms include non-designated and locally listed historic assets; records/frequency unknown; no related dataset or specification.
gate: Design metadata cannot establish local designation, significance, adopted-list status or parcel relationship.

name: Heritage at risk
fact: 5,490 records from 1 provider; collector 2026-01-26; new data 2025-09-30; Historic England attribution and annual-register context.
gate: Register inclusion is risk context, not asset extent, current condition survey, consent or exact parcel relation.

name: Heritage at risk design surface
fact: On the platform; expected records and frequency unknown; no technical specification or related dataset shown on the design surface.
gate: Design status does not establish current register currency, risk category, asset geometry or proposal effect.

name: Local resilience forum boundary
fact: 38 boundaries from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2026-06-20; ONS statistical geography with mixed/MHCLG-created platform origin.
gate: Administrative resilience boundary is routing context only and cannot produce parcel-level public-safety or hazard scores.

name: Public transport access node
fact: 363,324 access nodes from 1 provider; collector and new-data date 2026-07-21; national bus, rail, tram, metro, underground, air and ferry access points.
gate: Point existence does not prove walking route, service frequency, accessibility, capacity or parcel connectivity score.

name: NaPTAN design surface
fact: Test and iterate; expected 1,500,000 records; ad hoc updates; related transport-access-node dataset. DfT is identified as publisher.
gate: Expected count differs materially from current platform count; accessibility conclusions require current service, route and network evidence.

name: Built up area
fact: 7,157 areas from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2024-06-11; ONS statistical geography with mixed origin.
gate: Statistical built-up classification is not an adopted settlement boundary, allocation, capacity or exact parcel policy.

name: Green belt core
fact: 16 category records from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2025-05-08; categories group green-belt areas around urban areas.
gate: Core vocabulary is not green-belt geometry or evidence of exact parcel inclusion.

name: Design code characteristic
fact: 11 characteristics from 1 provider; collector 2026-02-22; new data 2024-06-11; includes context, identity, built-form, movement, nature and resources.
gate: Characteristic vocabulary does not impose an adopted rule, density or design requirement on a parcel.

name: Government organisation
fact: 23 organisations from 2 providers; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2025-02-28; maintained for planning/housing data-provider identity.
gate: Organisation identity is routing/provenance metadata, not geography, statutory consultation outcome or parcel evidence.

name: Local authority type
fact: 8 type codes from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2025-02-28: COMB, SRA, CC, UA, MD, NMD, LBO and CTY.
gate: Authority-type vocabulary does not establish the current decision-maker, plan policy or parcel result without linked authority evidence.

name: Nonprofit organisation
fact: 1 nonprofit organisation from 2 providers; collector 2026-06-18; new data 2025-02-28; mixed/MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Organisation routing data is not land ownership, service provision, constraint or opportunity evidence.

name: Waste disposal authority
fact: 5 waste authorities from 2 providers; collector 2026-07-18; new data 2025-02-28; includes current and dissolved organisational context.
gate: Authority identity does not identify a waste facility, allocation, collection service or parcel impact.

name: Public authority
fact: 1 public-authority record from 2 providers; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2025-02-28; mixed origin.
gate: A provider identity cannot establish statutory powers, consultation response or parcel constraint.

name: National underground asset register design surface
fact: Backlog Paused; records/frequency unknown; no related dataset. Design notes say NUAR is available through a portal for parties involved in digging and planning use remained under discovery.
gate: No open operational geometry is available for commercial parcel scoring; absence cannot establish absence of buried assets.

name: Aircraft noise design catalogue
fact: Official constraint catalogue lists Aircraft noise at Backlog stage, last updated 2025-01-28.
gate: Backlog label provides no contour, threshold, source currency or exact parcel noise exposure.

name: UK airport data design surface
fact: Backlog; airport-presence consideration; records/frequency unknown; no useful links, technical specification or related dataset.
gate: Airport presence or connectivity cannot be assigned to a parcel without current authoritative locations, operations and route/access evidence.
